def validate_otp(manager, otp_val=None, tmp_id=None):
    '''Confirm otp matches.'''
    otp = otp_val or frappe.form_dict.get('otp')
    if not otp:
        return True
    tmp_id = tmp_id or frappe.form_dict.get('tmp_id')
    token = frappe.cache().get(tmp_id + '_token')
    secret = frappe.cache().get(tmp_id + '_otp_secret')
    if not secret:
        raise ExpiredLoginException(_('Login session expired, refresh page to retry'))
    hotp = pyotp.HOTP(secret)
    if token and hotp.verify(otp, int(token)):
        frappe.cache().delete(tmp_id + '_token')
        return True
    if pyotp.TOTP(secret).verify(otp):
        if not frappe.db.get_default(manager.user + '_otplogin'):
            frappe.db.set_default(manager.user + '_otplogin', 1)
            delete_qrimage(manager.user)
        return True
    manager.fail(_('Incorrect Verification code'), manager.user)
    return True
